name: mdx-blog
description: File-based MDX content collection. List + detail page + RSS feed. No backend. Portable defineMdxBlog(opts) factory with 4 config props (basePath, contentDir, labels.list, nav) — defaults preserve the legacy /blog + content/blog surface.

postInstall: echo 'Create content/blog/ folder. Drop *.mdx files with frontmatter (title, date, slug).'

notes: Static file-based — zero database. Frontmatter parsed via gray-matter. Syntax highlighting via rehype-pretty-code (Shiki). RSS feed at /rss.xml. List view auto-sorts by frontmatter.date desc.
